goal: Make mobile party saving a staged action that closes the party picker and leaves an explicit Search action.

intent_model.literal_request: Saving the party should not search. It should close the popup and leave a Search button.
intent_model.implied_outcome: Mobile users can review and change all search fields before intentionally submitting once.
likely_rejections: The URL changes before Search is pressed

interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: No navigation, search tracking, or search submission occurs from the mobile party-save action.
interpretation_rules.acceptance_impact: Verify the URL and results remain unchanged after saving.

cognitive_flow.next_action: Review the full search and press Search
preserved_depth: Editing and reopening the party picker

predictive_preflight.no_applicable_lessons_reason: No accepted account lesson directly governs this local staged interaction; the VII feedback standard does.

natural_destination: Expanded VII search editor on a 390px mobile viewport

facts.claim: The current vacation party save button invokes search directly.
The approved VII standard keeps mobile search staged.

assumptions.claim: The existing overview Search button becomes visible when mobileStep returns to overview.
assumptions.validation: Focused CSS contract and live mobile browser check

invariants: Desktop committed choices may search immediately
Mobile search editor remains open until explicit Search or cancel
Selected composition survives picker close and reopen

requirements.statement: Mobile Save party closes only the party picker and does not submit search.
The full mobile search editor remains open with a visible Search button.
Selected composition persists until explicit Search.

acceptance_checks.setup: Open vacation search at 390px and open the party picker
acceptance_checks.action: Change counts and press Save party
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Party picker closes, editor stays open, URL is unchanged, and Search is visible

acceptance_checks.setup: Save a non-default party on mobile
acceptance_checks.action: Reopen the party picker, then press explicit Search
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Counts remain selected and are included in the resulting query

acceptance_checks.setup: Open the same picker at desktop width
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Search applies immediately using the latest party values

acceptance_checks.setup: Open the vacation party picker on mobile with a destination and dates already staged
acceptance_checks.action: Press Save party while monitoring navigation and search submission
acceptance_checks.observable_result: No navigation or search submission occurs before the explicit Search button is pressed

acceptance_checks.setup: Close and reopen the mobile party picker and switch viewport widths
acceptance_checks.observable_result: No stale overlay or scroll lock remains and Search is usable

authorization_boundary: Implement and verify locally only. Do not publish without a separate explicit instruction.
